name: Find The Array
justification: One clean bound (max sum of a size-k beautiful array is k^2) collapses it to a one-liner.
solution_sketch: A beautiful array of size k is maximized by 1,3,5,...,2k-1 with sum k^2, and any sum below that is reachable. So the answer is the least k with k^2 >= s, i.e. ceil(sqrt(s)) computed with integer sqrt.
